# Runtime

The runtime renders compiled template trees into HTML. It takes a tree structure where every expression is already a callable function, plus a data context, and walks the tree to produce output.

It is streaming-first: rendering is done via generators that yield string chunks, so HTML can be emitted incrementally.

- **[`js/`](js/README.md)** — the renderer. See [`docs/runtime-js.md`](../docs/runtime-js.md) for the usage API.

**`dom-patch/`** is the browser runtime that modules generated by [dom-patch](../compiler/generate/dom-patch/README.md#runtime) run on: it patches a server-rendered custom element from the data a module describes, using the JS runtime to render, choose and evaluate.

## Testing

Runtime tests run via Deno from the repo root:

```bash
deno task test
```
